decision_titles: Minutes of March 2026 meeting with amendments
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Technology Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, August 6, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 Marie Bravo called the meeting to order at 7:02pm. 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Marie Bravo, Steve Seaforth, Lisa Diggs, Sherry Kave, Danny Bruna & Chirs Atchley 
Guest Speaker Justin Schnieder 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
1. The commission reviewed the minutes for December 2025. 
o Steve Seaforth made a motion to approve the December meeting minutes. 
Lisa Diggs seconded the motion. All voting members were in favor. 
2. The commission reviewed the minutes for March 2026.Marie Bravo suggested 
some amendments to the March minutes.  
o No public comment received. 
o Outline the 4 key areas for the Line Budget Modernization from the Finance 
Committee: 
1. Find solutions to produce the finance report and data necessary for 
decision makers in an accessible format, and software to implement 
for monthly MUNIS reports. 
2. The town cannot use any AI until a formal policy is in place. 
3. Asset management software for vehicles, buildings, generators, etc. 
4. Additional grant writing capacity for the town. 
o Include the following discussion after the previous items listed: 
1. The Commission discussed the need to have a representative from 
the town, such as the mayor or someone he designates, attend 
meetings to better understand the budget and timeline for these 
initiatives. 
2. Partner with the town on these items, if they align with, The capacity 
and vision. 
3. Lisa Diggs made a motion to approve the minutes with the presented amendments 
mentioned by Commissioner Chair Bravo. Steve Seaforth seconded the motion. All 
voting members in favor. 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No public comment received.
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 Commission Chair Bravo reviewed the correspondence from Legislative Council member 
Doug Foley. 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 No executive session required. 
7. REPORTS   
 No reports to review. 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Updates from Hamden IT Dept. 
   
  Justin Schnieder reported on items 1, 3, & 4 from the Line Budget Modernization from 
the Finance Committee. 
  2. AI Policy and Technology Policy.  
  Justin Schnieder reported on the AI policy and addressed the comments left by the 
commission. 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 Lisa Diggs made a motion to adjourn the meeting. Steve Seaforth seconded the motion. All 
voting members were in favor.
